blocks.text: *Unwritten has **no fixed classes.** You are what you wield and where you invest.*
There are no Swordsmen or Mages to pick from. Instead, your gameplay identity emerges from two things you fully control:

items: **Your weapons** — the skills you have learned by practising them: the actives you press, and the passives that fire on their own.
**Your ring build** — where you pour your stat growth.

blocks.text: Change either and your character plays differently. Nothing boxes you into a preset template.

The weapon type in your hand decides which of the **skills you have learned** you may use. Practise a staff and you learn its spells; practise a bow and you learn its shots — and swapping to a weapon you have practised swaps you onto its skills. The weapon's type (sword, staff, bow, dagger…) also sets your attack feel and animation — but it does **not** gate what you're allowed to be. Each of the fourteen weapon types fights the way one of the **Fourteen Kashira** fought, so choosing a weapon is choosing whose story you're finishing. See **Weapons & Equipment**, **Skills**, and **The World of Unwritten**.

Your power scales off your **ring stats**, and that scaling is role-bound: **healing grows with MP**, **damage grows with Attack / Magic Attack**. Because ring investment is slow to change, it's what truly commits you to a role — a healer is someone who poured into MP, a damage-dealer someone who poured into Attack. See **Stats & the Ring**.
Put the two together and you get your character:

items: The **weapon** is the fast, swappable half — change which of your learned skills you use by changing what you hold.
The **ring** is the slow, committed half — your accumulated power and role.

blocks.text: A staff in the hands of an MP build heals and casts; the same staff on an Attack build barely tickles. That interplay is the whole build system.

items: **Front-line bruiser** — a melee weapon + an Attack / HP / Defense ring
**Ranged damage** — a bow + an Attack / Accuracy ring
**Battle-mage** — a staff + a Magic Attack ring
**Healer / support** — a support weapon + an MP ring

blocks.text: These are just illustrations of what the two levers can produce — you can rebuild toward any of them by changing your weapon and steering your ring; none of them is a locked class.

text: *This replaces an earlier "classes" concept that is no longer part of the design. Identity in Unwritten is weapon + ring, full stop.*
